stem:
The tables of ordered pairs represent some points on the graphs of lines f and g.

Line f
|  x  |  y  |
|  2  |  7  |
|  4  | 10.5 |
|  7  | 15.75|
| 11  | 22.75|

Line g
|  x  |  y  |
| -3  |  4  |
| -2  |  0  |
|  1  | -12 |
|  4  | -24 |

Which system of equations represents lines f and g?
visual_elements: Table for line g with pairs (-3,4), (-2,0), (1,-12), (4,-24)
